name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description_en: A central government scheme that pays Rs 6,000 per year in three equal instalments to eligible landholding farmer families, subject to the published exclusions.
eligibility: A farmer family means husband, wife and minor children who own cultivable land according to the State or Union Territory land records
The scheme covers landholding farmer families, not only small and marginal farmers

Exclusions include institutional landholders; present or former constitutional office holders, ministers and specified elected office holders; most serving or retired government and public-sector employees; pensioners receiving Rs 10,000 or more per month; people who paid income tax in the last assessment year; and practising registered doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects
documents_required: Aadhaar card for mandatory electronic Know Your Customer (e-KYC)
where_to_apply: PM-KISAN portal, a Common Service Centre, or the local revenue office

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description_en: A public health-assurance scheme providing cashless hospital treatment cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year; all people aged 70 or above can enrol regardless of income or economic status.
eligibility: Existing eligibility routes cover families identified through the Socio-Economic and Caste Census 2011 deprivation or occupation criteria and any state-specific expansion
Every senior citizen aged 70 or above is eligible regardless of socio-economic status; age is determined from Aadhaar
For families already covered, members aged 70 or above receive a separate additional cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per year for themselves
documents_required: For the age-70-and-above route: Aadhaar is the only enrolment document and Aadhaar-based electronic Know Your Customer is mandatory
where_to_apply: Ayushman App, beneficiary.nha.gov.in, a Common Service Centre, or an empanelled hospital help desk

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description_en: A rural housing scheme giving financial assistance to build a pucca house to families in the government's housing-deprived list.
eligibility: Household must be listed as houseless or living in a kutcha house in the Awaas+ / Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) housing deprivation data
Household should not already own a pucca house anywhere in India
exclusions: A household member owns a motorised three-wheeler or four-wheeler
A household member owns mechanised three-wheeler or four-wheeler agricultural equipment
The household has a Kisan Credit Card with a credit limit of Rs 50,000 or more
A household member is a government employee
The household has a non-agricultural enterprise registered with the government
A household member earns more than Rs 15,000 per month
A household member pays income tax or professional tax
The household owns 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land
The household owns 5 acres or more of unirrigated land
The house has more than two rooms
documents_required: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) job card if available
where_to_apply: Gram Panchayat office or Block Development Office

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) Job Card
description_en: A law that guarantees at least 100 days of paid unskilled manual work in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members demand work.
eligibility: Household must be resident in a rural area
Adult member(s) willing to do unskilled manual work

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description_en: A common application portal for many different scholarships. It cannot provide one scheme-specific deadline: opening, closing and verification dates are published separately for each scholarship and academic year.
eligibility: Must be enrolled in a recognised school or institution
Family income must be below the scheme-specific income ceiling
Category-specific criteria vary by scholarship; check the selected scheme notice for the full category names and rules
where_to_apply: Online at the National Scholarship Portal, verified by the institution and district nodal officer

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description_en: A small-savings account for a girl child. The government-notified interest rate can change, and the account matures 21 years from the date it was opened.
eligibility: Account can be opened for a girl child below 10 years of age
Maximum two accounts per family (three in case of twins/triplets on second birth)
where_to_apply: Post office or authorised bank branch

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description_en: Provides an eligible adult woman from a poor household with a deposit-free liquefied petroleum gas connection, a free first refill and a free two-burner stove.
eligibility: Applicant must be a woman aged 18 or older from a poor household, based on the prescribed deprivation declaration
No family member in the household composition document may already have a liquefied petroleum gas connection from an Oil Marketing Company
documents_required: Aadhaar of the applicant and adult family members
Address proof if the current address differs from Aadhaar
Bank account number and Indian Financial System Code
where_to_apply: Nearest liquefied petroleum gas distributor or the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana online application page

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) — Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description_en: Central old-age pension assistance for people aged 60 or above in below-poverty-line households. States and Union Territories may add their own top-up, so the total monthly payment varies by state.
eligibility: Applicant must be 60 years or older
Must belong to a household below the poverty line under the scheme criteria
The central share is Rs 200 per month for ages 60 to 79 and Rs 500 per month from age 80; state or Union Territory top-ups vary and must be checked locally
documents_required: below poverty line (BPL) certificate / ration card
where_to_apply: Gram Panchayat or Block/Taluk Social Welfare office
